Both the positive cross-check and the negative-sample loop.
gateDefectsFoundByTheReRun.whyUnnoticed: the last recorded G3.b run is 2026-07-22, BEFORE compaction shipped; the 0.6.0 attempt was aborted without a verdict (the pkill self-kill), so no run has reached this code since the field moved.
gateDefectsFoundByTheReRun.fix: --full on both calls, plus a named refusal when a served harvest carries no id instead of crashing inside BigInt

gateDefectsFoundByTheReRun.defect: failed with 20 'no is.score hash entity' violations that were the gate's own bug: it hashes on the leaderboard row's raw holder id, which is --full-only since 0.5.0 (src/queries/build.ts: `if (full) account.id = score.holderID`), so every sampled row hashed BigInt(undefined). The compact 50-row cap also silently shrank its 'every 200th' sampling to 'the first 50'.
